title: Cybertruck bomber's email to Shoemate about Chinese gravitic drones

tellings.quote: And then you have this guy going on Sean Ryan uh Shoemate saying that he received an email from the Green Beret himself, the bomber,
Matthew had emailed him saying that the New Jersey drones that the entire country has been confused about for the last two months are actually state-of-the-art gravitic propulsion drones from China
tellings.difference: Names Livelsberger and the New Jersey drones of the past two months, and credits the FBI; the story places the drones on the Eastern Seaboard.
tellings.link_reason: Both describe the Cybertruck bomber Livelsberger's email to Shoemate, as told on Shawn Ryan's show, claiming the drones were Chinese gravitic craft.

as_told.title: Livelsberger email: New Jersey drones are Chinese gravitic drones

plain: Matthew Livelsberger, a Green Beret soldier who blew up a Tesla Cybertruck in Las Vegas in 2025, had emailed a man named Sam Shoemate saying the mysterious drones seen over New Jersey and the East Coast in the previous two months were cutting-edge Chinese drones that fly by gravitic propulsion, a way of moving by manipulating gravity. Michels tells this on two episodes, saying Shoemate described the email on the podcast of Shawn Ryan, and once citing the FBI as well.
